MindFuture’s application to The Cultural Council, Høje Taastrup Municipality

On the occasion of Vestegnen's Culture Week 2022, MindFuture at Erik Husfeldts Vej 7 will host two art events about democracy and artificial intelligence, which relate to the municipality's theme of open cultural communities. We hereby seek support to honor two artists, while MindFuture covers all other expenses related to holding the events.


The format is a "voter meeting" for the project The Synthetic Party, driven by artist and philosopher [the operator]. Over two afternoons on the weekend 10/11 September, the party will invite ordinary people into a culture where the machines set the agenda. For this, we expect to engage 200-400 people over the two days. Through collaboration with Høje Taastrup Libraries, the artists will tailor the format so it can be part of the Culture Package, allowing us to invite school classes in the senior grades.

About The Synthetic Party
The Synthetic Party was launched in June 2022, and has received some media coverage. The party is led by an artificial intelligence that has read all the crazy and wild ideas that ordinary people have written on the internet in connection with their private establishment of small parties. In this way, the party can demonstrate what kinds of political representation become possible with artificial intelligence, and show ordinary citizens' visions without a human filter.

Specifically about the events 
The two events will take the form of hands-on workshops, where [the operator] [████] guides people in communicating with a political chatbot, creating logos and icons with artificial intelligence, and composing digital poetry with both words and images through technology. Participants will, perhaps for the first time, try talking to an AI, participate in "policy development", and learn tools to program themselves with easy and publicly available machine learning tools.

The two artists will establish a situation where participants are members of The Synthetic Party and thus will feel that they have the possibility to influence the technology – rather than it have influence over them. Thus, the purpose is to strengthen democratic education so that new phenomena like ’spam bots’ and ’troll armies’ do not appear as alien creatures from another world, but as something one can understand and take responsibility for.
Budget
